spans.text:
You are currently running autonomously. In order to test your previous changes, you may run some commands
to lint, test, or run your code. Give the commands as a new-line separated list, like this:
spans.note: The prompt instructs the system to run commands autonomously without user confirmation or validation. While it does scope commands to specific files, the instruction to run autonomously without any safety checks, validation of command content, or user approval before execution raises tool safety concerns. The system is told it is 'currently running autonomously' and to just provide commands to execute.

spans.text: Do *NOT* provide any additional context, or your response will not be parsed correctly!
spans.note: The prompt explicitly instructs the system not to provide any additional context, which removes the user's ability to understand what is being done and why. Combined with autonomous execution, this undermines user agency and informed oversight of consequential actions.
